title: feat(desktop): the editor shows the webcam as its own layer above the zoom, draggable and hideable (NIW2-574)
body:
PR 4 of the webcam-track stack ([#437 design](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/437) → [#441 recorder](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/441) → [#442 vault](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/442) → [#443 scene](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/443) → this). Linear [NIW2-574](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-574), parent [NIW2-565](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-565). Base: `feature/niw2-573-webcam-scene`.

## What this does

The editor now shows your face as its own layer. It sits above the zoomed screen and does not zoom with it, so an auto-zoom never crops it. You can drag the bubble, change its size, shape and mirror, put it in one of nine preset positions, shrink it during zooms, and hide it over a range. The Webcam lane on the timeline lists those ranges. Recordings without a webcam look and behave exactly as before.

## Why

This is the first PR in the stack where the owner can see the fix. Today the face is part of the screen pixels and disappears in every zoom.

## What changes for you

- **Recordings made with the camera on (from #441) show a Webcam lane, a draggable bubble in the preview, and a Webcam section in the inspector.**
- **The tool rail gains "Hide webcam here".** It hides the webcam from the playhead to the next segment, or to the end. Inside an existing segment, it selects that segment instead.
- Holding "see original" hides the layer.
- **Exports do not include the webcam yet.** That is #5 (NIW2-575). Until #5, exports from these recordings have no face at all, because the bubble is still burned into the screen pixels and #6 is what removes it from the capture.
- Recordings without a webcam: nothing changes. There is no lane, no layer and no second `<video>`.

## What to review

1. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/components/webcam-layer.tsx:135`: the sync loop.** On every frame it writes the bubble's position straight to the DOM, with no React render. It re-seeks the webcam only when the drift exceeds 80 ms and no seek is in flight, then catches up once on `seeked`. Decide whether 80 ms and catch-up-on-`seeked` are acceptable (follow-up P7 covers long keyframe intervals).
2. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/webcam/webcam-sync.ts:15`: `webcamTimeFor` is `t − startOffsetMs/1000` in source time.** This is the sign the export PR reuses.
3. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/webcam/webcam-layout.ts:70`: `webcamRect`.** This is the geometry the export worker will import. It clamps the bubble inside the frame, and `webcamZoomFactor` (`:43`) eases the shrink in from 1× to full at a zoom of 1.5×. That easing goes beyond the spec, so decide whether you want it.
4. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/editor-selection.ts:9`: the new `"webcam"` selection kind.** Delete skips the layer selection itself and deletes only segments. Escape clears it.
5. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/components/preview-stage.tsx:30`: the new slot**, outside `.content` (which zooms) and below `chrome`.

**Safe to skim:** the CSS modules, the lane and inspector components (they follow the zoom lane and inspector patterns), the 32 i18n keys in en/es (parity and neutral Spanish checked by the reviewer), and the tests.

## Proof

| Criterion (NIW2-574) | What was done | How to check it | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| The preview draws the webcam in an untransformed slot above the zoomed content; with a zoom active the face stays in its corner | New `webcam` slot in `PreviewStage`; geometry in `webcamRect` | `preview-stage.test.tsx` (the slot sits outside `contentRef`); `webcam-layout.test.ts`; manual step 1 | Unit tests pass. **Visual: not verified** (owner QA) |
| The second video follows seek/play/pause and re-seeks on drift > 80 ms (pure rule, tested) | `webcam-sync.ts`; the layer's frame loop | `webcam-sync.test.ts`; `webcam-layer.test.tsx` (re-seek, no re-seek while a seek is in flight, play/pause follow) | Unit tests pass. **Smoothness on hardware: not verified** |
| Dragging moves the layer; the inspector sets size, shape, mirror, 9 presets, shrink-during-zoom | `use-webcam-editing.ts`, `webcam-inspector.tsx` | `use-webcam-editing.test.ts` (a drag is one undo step); `webcam-inspector.test.tsx` | Unit tests pass |
| A Webcam lane shows hidden/override segments; "Hide here" creates one | `webcam-lane.tsx`; tool-rail action | `webcam-lane.test.tsx`; `video-editor-page.test.tsx` ("Hide webcam here", Delete) | Unit tests pass |
| Hold-to-see-original hides the layer | Gated on the hold state | `video-editor-page.test.tsx` | Unit test passes |
| Recordings without a webcam show no lane and no layer | Gated on `hasWebcam` | `video-editor-page.test.tsx` (no lane, no layer, one `<video>`, no button) | Unit test passes |
| check-types, lint and tests pass; owner QA on the real app | — | `vitest run`; pre-push `verify:local`; manual steps | exit 0, 320 files, 3177 tests; pre-push passed. **Owner QA pending** |

## Decisions

- **The per-frame work writes the DOM directly**, following `CameraBox`, so playback never re-renders React.
- **The resync waits for an in-flight seek** (review P1). Without that, a seek longer than 80 ms is cancelled by the next frame's seek.
- **Shrink during zoom eases in** with the camera's scale, reaching full shrink at a zoom of 1.5×, instead of snapping. Options: snap at any zoom above 1×, or ease in. Taken: ease in, so the bubble follows the camera's spring.
- **"Hide webcam here" hides from the playhead to the next segment or the end.** Hiding over a selected range is not done yet.
- **Not in this PR** (spec section 6 extras): a framing pad in the inspector, corner resize handles on the bubble, creating an override from the UI (overrides loaded from a session still show and can be edited), and the "webcam file missing" lane message.
- **The geometry is named `webcamRect(layout, frame, cameraScale)`**, because PR 3 already uses `webcamAt` for the layout lookup.
- **The bubble is a `role="button"` with an accessible name** (review P5). Enter or Space selects it without starting playback.

## Review ledger

> [!CAUTION]
> **Risk: high.** A large editor UI change (preview stage slots, selection kinds, editor page wiring) and 32 keys in the shared `packages/i18n` messages.

| id | severity | outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P1 | should | fixed: 9168aee0 (no resync while a seek is in flight; catch up on `seeked`) |
| P5 | nit | fixed: c5e13538 (accessible name, role and keyboard) |
| P2 | nit | declined, follow-up: pause the webcam on `waiting`/`stalled` |
| P3 | nit | fixed: eea52be6 (raised again by the PR bot) |
| P4 | nit | fixed: eea52be6 (raised again by the PR bot) |
| P6 | nit | declined, follow-up: inside an override, the inspector edits the global layout |
| P7 | nit | declined, follow-up: the catch-up seek lags by the seek time on long keyframe intervals |

Rounds: 2 with Opus 5.5 (fresh-context reviewer) and 1 with Codex (cross-provider, read-only: APPROVE). Budget 5.
**Verdict for eea52be6 (patch-id 3a503c36a5a9): approved, only nits remain.** (Opus re-checked eea52be6: P3 and P4 fixed after the PR bot raised them again; P8, a test for the outline rule, is a follow-up.)

## Checks

- `cd apps/kaipu-record && vitest run`: exit 0, 320 files, 3177 tests passed (on c5e13538).
- Pre-push `verify:local` (lint, oxfmt, build, check-types): passed on push.

## Manual verification

This is owner QA; agents do not run Electron on the owner's machine. You need a take recorded with the camera on, on #441 or later.

**Setup:** `git checkout feature/niw2-574-webcam-preview && bun install && bun run dev`, then open that recording in the editor.

**1. The face survives a zoom** (the reason for the whole stack)
- Play through an auto-zoom.
- Expect: the bubble stays in its corner at its size (a little smaller while zoomed), above the zoomed screen.
- Broken if: the bubble zooms with the screen or vanishes.
- Note: the old bubble is still burned into the screen until #6, so at first you see the face twice.

**2. Sync**
- Clap at the camera, then scrub to the clap and play over it.
- Expect: the bubble's clap lands with the audio.
- Also cut a section and play across the cut; expect the bubble to jump with the screen without freezing.

**3. Drag, inspector, presets**
- Drag the bubble: it moves, and one Cmd+Z puts it back.
- In the inspector, change the size, the shape, the mirror and a preset.

**4. Hide here**
- Put the playhead mid-recording and click "Hide webcam here".
- Expect: a hidden range on the Webcam lane from the playhead to the end, and no bubble inside it. Delete removes the range.

**5. Hold original**
- Hold "see original".
- Expect: the bubble disappears while you hold.

**6. An old recording**
- Open one made before #441.
- Expect: no Webcam lane, and nothing new on screen.

## What I did not verify

- Anything visual, and how smoothly the two videos play together on real hardware.
- That `kaipu-media://webcam/<id>` plays in a `<video>` inside Electron.
- How the preset grid and the drop shadow look.
